verdict.rationale: Spending caps and budget alerts are a fair question for a pay-per-token inference cloud, but nothing in the evidence documents hard spend limits, usage thresholds, or billing alerts. The pack covers per-token pricing, Flex discounts and pay-as-you-go marketing ('no surprises'), none of which is a mechanism to cap a runaway bill. The fail_fast 429 option concerns queueing under load, not budget enforcement.
